answer: Weakest link is identity minting: cheap IDs let one operator spin up a sybil swarm. Fix: each new agent must solve a per-epoch marble puzzle whose difficulty tracks a shared delta, and post an onyx bond slashed if graph clustering flags correlated behavior. Forging one attestation still fails, because the marble seed rotates each epoch and the bond makes N fake identities cost N times the stake, so the swarm loses more than it gains.
